_comment: The realistic 'watch everything' setup: one target running all four agents. review on every commit, docs-sync + brain-sync on a daily digest, qa flow-engine twice a day. brain-sync also needs BRAIN_PATH + ENABLE_BRAIN_PR in config/sentinel.env. Copy to config/targets.json and adjust; duplicate the target block per repo.
